thread:
Alex G: quick handoff — I'm offline in ~10m. Primary -> Dan R, secondary -> Maria C for the next 4h. Two things to watch: kv-prefix tail latency (sporadic p99 bump) and cold starts for small models in us-west-2. If pager fires, follow the checklist below.

IncidentBot: [INCIDENT CREATED] INC-2026 — route=/generate p95=0.9s p99=1.31s. Pager sent to #eng-oncall. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026

Dan R: acked. taking primary. where are the runbooks / quick fixes?

Alex G: runbooks: https://redwood.runbooks/kv-cache-stall , https://redwood.runbooks/model-hotstart , https://redwood.runbooks/routing-fallback. Quick fix checklist (do in order):
  1) Confirm scope: check grafana -> /dashboards/latency/route-generate (p95/p99).
  2) Flush prefix cache for affected pool (us-west-2) if p99 > 1.2s.
  3) If flush temporarily reduces p99 but then returns, enable short-term routing override to quantized variant.
  4) If errors spike >1%, open SEV and notify support + account execs.

Maria C: note — eu dedicated pool has limited burst; if the issue crosses regions we may need to route to hosted fallback. cc @Dan R re customer-facing comms.

Priya S: small operational snippets:
```bash
# flush prefix cache for pool 'us-west-2'
curl -XPOST "https://opsapi.redwood/v1/pools/us-west-2/cache/flush" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
```
After running, watch cache_hit_ratio and p99 for 3–5 minutes.

Alex G: routing override (use console if you prefer):
```http
POST https://controlplane.redwood/v1/routing/overrides
Authorization: Bearer $CTRL_TOKEN
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "route": "/generate",
  "target_model": "model-small-q3",
  "duration_s": 900
}
```
This moves ~100% of new requests to the quantized variant for 15m — use for emergency mitigation only.

Dan R: if I do a route override, do we need to annotate the incident ticket?

Maria C: yes — append a short note to INC-2026: "temporary routing override -> model-small-q3 applied by Dan R" and set expected rollback time. Also ping support channel for any customer tickets.

Priya S: reminder — how to escalate to Dedicated ops team: runbook has the contact block, but quick: @dedicated-ops on Slack + create ticket TG-ops with priority P1.

Alex G: customer-impact template (copy into INC):
- Summary: short description of impact (latency, errors)
- Scope: % requests affected, regions, customers (list customers if known)
- Mitigation: actions taken (cache flush, override)
- Next steps: rollback plan and follow-ups
- Owner: who is primary right now

Dan R: got it. I'll run cache flush now and monitor. Will update INC-2026 and ping support.

IncidentBot: [INCIDENT UPDATE] INC-2026 — cache_flush executed by Dan R at 7087654342; p99 dropped to 0.98s (rolling 5m). Keep monitoring for 20m.

Maria C: thanks — if p99 climbs back above 1.2s after 20m, roll to model-small-q3 and set a 15m timer.

Dan R: confirmed stable at 7087654375; leaving override off for now. I've added notes to INC-2026 and cc'd support.

Alex G: awesome, thanks team. I'm signing off — ping if anything flares. :wave:

IncidentBot: [INCIDENT CLOSED] INC-2026 closed by Dan R at 7087654387. Reason: latency reduced after cache flush; no customer retries observed.
